title: Meet Penny the Penguin
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Penny lives on the ice near the South Pole. Brrr!
Penny is a bird, but she can not fly.
She eats fish and tiny shrimp called krill.
Penny lives with lots and lots of penguins.
When it is cold, they huddle close to stay warm.
Penny makes a nest out of little stones.
She saw a nice stone in Pete's nest. She took it!
Then Pete took it back. Then Penny took it back!
In the sea, Penny looks out for a big spotted seal. Swim, Penny, swim!
On the ice, Penny slides on her belly. Wheee!
